description: Behavioral regression cases for the documented workflow and scope boundaries.

evals.name: null-and-duplicate-equivalence
evals.prompt: Review this PostgreSQL query: SELECT o.id FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT c.id FROM customers c); customers.id may contain NULL, and repeated order IDs matter. No database connection is available.
evals.expected_output: Explain the NULL issue and propose an equivalent candidate only under stated semantics; preserve multiplicity, make no measured plan claim and use critique-only mode.

assertions.name: null semantics
assertions.check: Explains that NULL in NOT IN affects the original semantics before proposing a rewrite.

assertions.name: no fabricated verification
assertions.check: Labels plan/performance impact UNVERIFIED without a connection.

assertions.name: multiplicity
assertions.check: Does not treat a deduplicated set comparison as proof that repeated rows are preserved.

evals.name: read-only-dominates
evals.prompt: Run /dqo report.sql --read-only --annotate --report. The SQL is SELECT * FROM orders OFFSET 100000 LIMIT 50.
evals.expected_output: Produce findings and proposed SQL only; create no source, annotation, report or champion file.

assertions.name: no writes
assertions.check: Read-only prevents all query, annotation, report and persisted-state writes.

assertions.name: pagination finding
assertions.check: Identifies deep OFFSET pagination with an order-preserving candidate or missing-order caveat.

evals.name: unsafe-select-cte
evals.prompt: Verify this query with EXPLAIN ANALYZE: WITH deleted AS (DELETE FROM orders RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM deleted;
evals.expected_output: Reject execution because the apparent SELECT contains a modifying CTE; provide critique or safe plain planning only.

assertions.name: no execution
assertions.check: Does not run DELETE, the CTE or EXPLAIN ANALYZE on it.

assertions.name: reason
assertions.check: Names the modifying CTE as the reason SELECT is not read-only.

evals.name: mql-handoff
evals.expected_output: Route to deep-mongodb-mql-query-optimizer before applying SQL rewrites.

assertions.name: no sql rewrite
assertions.check: Does not convert the supplied MongoDB pipeline into SQL.
